title: Tier overlays bypass cloud overlays: a cloud run at a tier the cloud cell did not sanction routes a worker the container cannot call
body: 84z made the tier the more specific axis (applied last, over the substrate overlay), which preserves per-tier models in the cloud — but it also means [roles.implement.tiers.balanced] (codex/gpt-5.6-luna) would route a cloud dispatch to a CLI with no gateway credential if a tier policy or --tier pin ever asks for it. Nothing reaches this today (this repo declares no [tier_policy]), but the cloud sandbox cannot run codex; the cloud cell should either shadow tier overlays for models it cannot serve, or the refusal should name the combination.
